# usually exclude such endpoints, so this corpus has its own looser budget.
# placement: form,multipart

Prepared statements prevent SQL injection, never concatenate user input.

Set the environment variable before starting the server.

Logs are under /var/log/myapp/ and rotate daily.
In React, useEffect runs after render; pass an empty array to run it once.

You can escape HTML with a library instead of writing your own sanitizer.
In Go, a nil map can be read but not written.
Use context.WithTimeout to cancel long-running requests.
The function returns an error if the file doesn't exist.

Java's Optional helps avoid NullPointerException.
In C#, async void should only be used for event handlers.
PHP 8 introduced named arguments and match expressions.
Ruby on Rails migrations can be rolled back with rails db:rollback.
Our CI pipeline caches node_modules between runs.
The regex ^[a-z0-9_-]{3,16}$ validates usernames.
I'm using the template syntax with double curly braces in Vue and it renders the variable fine.
In Jinja you loop with for/endfor blocks.
YAML is indentation-sensitive, so check your spaces vs tabs.
The XML file has a DOCTYPE declaration but no external entities.
Base64-encode the credentials and send them in the Authorization header.
JWTs have three parts separated by dots: header, payload, signature.
CORS errors happen when the server doesn't return Access-Control-Allow-Origin.
Set SameSite=Lax on the session cookie.
The Content-Security-Policy header blocks inline scripts by default.
Rate limiting returns 429 Too Many Requests.

Check the TLS certificate chain with openssl s_client.

Use pprof to find where the CPU time goes.
The test is flaky because it depends on wall-clock time.
Mock the HTTP client instead of calling the real API in unit tests.
We use feature flags to roll out the change to 10% of users.
Blue-green deployment lets us switch traffic back instantly.
Our SLO is 99.9% availability per 30 days.

Add your public key to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the server, then chmod 600 it.
aws configure stores the access key in ~/.aws/credentials by default.
Run kubectl config view; it reads ~/.kube/config unless KUBECONFIG is set.
